name: Pathway proteins via PARTICIPATES_IN
cypher: MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Pathway) WHERE p.name = 'Signal Transduction' RETURN prot.name LIMIT 10

name: Pathway by name
cypher: MATCH (p:Pathway) WHERE p.name CONTAINS 'Insulin' RETURN p.name

name: Largest pathways by protein count
cypher: MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Pathway) RETURN p.name, count(prot) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most connected proteins (interaction hub)
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein) RETURN p1.name, count(p2) AS interactions ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 10

name: Protein → Pathway → Sibling proteins
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) WHERE p1.name = 'TP53' RETURN pw.name, p2.name LIMIT 10

name: Regulation targets
cypher: MATCH (a)-[:REGULATES]->(b) RETURN labels(a)[0] AS src_type, labels(b)[0] AS tgt_type LIMIT 10

name: Shared pathways between interacting proteins
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein) WHERE p1.name = 'TP53' WITH p2 LIMIT 1 MATCH (p2)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN p2.name, pw.name LIMIT 10

name: Proteins in immune system pathway
cypher: MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Pathway) WHERE p.name = 'Immune System' RETURN prot.name LIMIT 20

name: Protein interaction network depth 2
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p3:Protein) WHERE p1.name = 'EGFR' AND p1 <> p3 RETURN p2.name, p3.name LIMIT 10
